subject: gk
question: In the context of Mineral distribution of India, which of the following is INCORRECT regarding the "South-Western Plateau region"?

options.text: It covers Karnataka, Goa and contiguous Tamil Nadu uplands and Kerala.
This belt is rich in ferrous metals and bauxite
It contains high grade iron ore.
This belt has huge amount of coal reserves.

solution:
The correct answer is __**This belt has huge amount of coal reserves**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **South-Western Plateau region** covers parts of **Karnataka, Goa, Tamil Nadu uplands, and Kerala**. These areas are known for their mineral wealth. *Hence, statement 1 is correct.*
 
• This region is particularly **rich in ferrous metals**, such as iron ore, and **bauxite**, which is used for aluminum production. *Hence, statement 2 is correct.*
 
• The region is a significant source of **high-grade iron ore**, which is exported to various countries for steel production. *Hence, statement 3 is correct.*
 
• The statement that this region has a "huge amount of coal reserves" is **incorrect**. The South-Western Plateau region is not known for coal reserves, as coal is predominantly found in the **Damodar Valley regions (Jharkhand, West Bengal)** and parts of Chhattisgarh and Odisha. *Hence, statement 4 is incorrect.*</li&
